hero.title: Quake Champions tournaments
hero.lead: Registration, check-in, bracket, veto, results and ranking for your community's tournaments, all in one place. In duels or teams.
hero.room: Just want the veto and the draft? <link>Open a veto room</link>, no account needed.
hero.shot: The bracket of a double-elimination tournament, with the first-round matches decided.

community.title: Create the community
community.body: Players join through its invite link.

tournament.title: Set up the tournament
tournament.body: Choose the format, map pool and date. Check-in opens on its own before the start.

play.title: Let the bracket run
play.body: Players veto and submit each game. The organizers only handle what's disputed.

tour.title: From veto to ranking
tour.room: Try it in a veto room

veto.title: Maps decided live
veto.body: Veto, vote or draw, however the tournament sets it. Each step has a timer. If time runs out, the choice is drawn at random.
veto.shot: A match veto in progress: whose turn it is to ban, the time left, and the maps, with banned maps in gray.

draft.title: The match's draft before game 1
draft.body: Bans apply to both sides in every game. After that, each player picks the champion for each game. The tournament sets how many bans there are and what can repeat.
draft.shot: A match draft in progress: whose turn it is to pick, the champion portraits with banned ones in gray, and beside them the bans and each game's champions.

result.title: One side submits, the other confirms
result.body: Each game is entered with its frags and a screenshot of the scoreboard. Without a response by the deadline, the submitted result stands. If disputed, it goes to the organizers.
result.shot: A match with each game's scoreboard and the next game waiting to be submitted, with each side's map and champion.

ranking.title: The community's Elo rating
ranking.body: Each confirmed game changes the rating of the players involved, in duels and in teams. With it, the organizers set the seeding and balance the teams.
ranking.shot: A community's ranking, with each member's rating, games and wins.

formats.title: Formats
formats.body: Single or double elimination, round robin and Swiss.

teams.title: Teams of 2 to 4
teams.body: Formed by draw or balanced by rating, with a captain and substitutions during the tournament.

notices.title: Notices
notices.body: Match ready, disputed game, and start time reach the site, your phone and the community's Discord.

languages.title: English, Portuguese and Spanish
languages.body: The site, notices and tournament text in all three languages.

closing.title: Set up your community's first tournament
